sourceSentences: Zilean throws a ticking time bomb to the target location that briefly grants sight of its surroundings as it travels as well as while lingering in the area. The bomb will attach itself to units that move within the epicenter, or those hit directly at the time of the bomb's landing, revealing them and their surroundings.
After 3 seconds, or when the attached unit dies, the bomb explodes to deal magic damage to nearby enemies.
The bomb detonates immediately if another bomb attaches itself to the same unit, stunning nearby enemies for a duration.

Time Bombs landing directly on top of multiple units follow a priority order for whom to attach themselves to. Units already carrying a bomb, Enemy champions, Allied champions, Enemy minions, Allied minions
When Time Bomb snaps onto an enemy, it deals 0 proc damage. This triggers in-combat effects such as drawing turret aggro and drawing monster aggression.
Time Bomb can deal damage to the enemy holder through untargetablility.
Spell shield will prevent the application of Time Bomb and its detonation damage as well as block the stun, but not its immediate detonation if the target already has a Time Bomb on them.
Zilean reduces the remaining cooldowns of Time Bomb and Time Warp by 10 seconds each.
Either Time Bomb or Time Warp must be on cooldown to cast this ability.
Zilean applies Time Warp to the target champion which lasts for 2.5 seconds. If the target is an ally, they gain bonus movement speed. If the target is an enemy, they are slowed.
Zilean places a protective time rune on the target allied champion or himself for 5 seconds.
If the target takes fatal damage within the duration, they enter resurrection for 3 seconds, becoming invulnerable, untargetable, and unable to act. Afterwards, they revive while being healed.
The channel is interrupted and disabled upon entering combat with enemy champions or taking damage from turrets, placing it on a 10-second cooldown.
The target allied champion is not required to be within range of Zilean for the channel to complete successfully, it will complete regardless of if they move to a far distance.
Additionally , placing a bomb on any champion will also put the ability on cooldown, but placing it on minions will not.
We can use our knowledge of bomb priority to our advantage by targeting minions and then targeting the minion that already has the bomb to stun nearby champions.
When a bomb hits an enemy champion, it counts as a negative effect (debuff). Therefore, even when they become untargetable, the damage is still applied .

Okay, the QQ W buffer is honestly a lot of talk and I do n't think it's that useful, but to do it , you press a second Q during the casting time of the first Q, and when you press W, it will come out instantly.
Well, there are many disadvantages to this, such as the fact that it locks the mouse cursor where you inserted the buffer, and it's very easy to miss and lose a Q.
If this is thrown onto any unit, ally or enemy, it sticks to them. Or if they walk through it, they also pick it up.
For combos, E your opponent into Q, then reset your cool downs with W. Follow up with Q to stun them and then attack away before using E again to slow them.
Slowing your opponent with E basically guarantees your double Q unless they flash.
on the enemy or on a minion near them, immediately press W to reset Q's cooldown
Zilean can throw Q, press W to reset Q's cooldown, then immediately throw a second Q.
Follow up with E slow on the stunned target for guaranteed auto-attacks from your ADC.
Using Rewind to reset Time Warp allows Zilean to speed up an ally, Rewind, then slow an enemy.
identify which ally is going to be focused first and pre-cast Chronoshift on them.
the key is casting R before the killing blow, not after.
The secret tech Zilean mains abuse is doing Q>Q>W instead.
This works by queueing up your second Q immediately, making the combo considerably faster.
